name: Maputo Central Railway Station
subtitle: A railway terminus in the city centre, built in the colonial period with a copper-clad dome.

facts.label: Eiffel attribution (conflict)
facts.value: EBSCO attributes the station to Eiffel and dates it to 1910, which conflicts with the architect names above. Treat the Eiffel link as disputed; do not state it as fact.

parts.text: A railway terminus in the city centre, built in the colonial period with a copper-clad dome. Its design is credited to Alfredo Augusto Lisboa de Lima and Mario Veiga, with the dome by José Ferreira da Costa.

gaps: The description is summarised from the sources listed here and should be read against them.
